michael: Heads-up — on the Acme onboarding they hit two issues: Splunk HEC dropping lines for audit events >64k, and S3 export KMS decrypt failures when we set encryption-context headers. Anyone seen this?

olivia: Seen it. Their path is webhook -> our adapter -> Splunk HEC. Adapter trims long events and doesn't forward our custom headers. Also noticed some adapters still expect `actor` (old schema) instead of `principal` (schema_v2) which breaks downstream parsing.

raj: I added X-RW-Audit-Bytes last week but adapter wasn't updated to forward it. If Splunk adapter strips headers we need an envelope in the payload or stick checksum + size in the JSON root so SIEMs can validate before ingest.

michael: Can someone drop a minimal redacted failing payload so support can reproduce?

eva: Pasting a sanitized sample from staging (schema_v2):
```json
{
  "event_type": "access_grant",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T21:12:05Z",
  "request_id": "req-0a1b2c3d",
  "principal": {"id": "u-123", "role": "platform_admin"},
  "resource": {"type": "model", "id": "open-llama-13b"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": {"client_ip": "REDACTED"},
  "kms": {"kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-efgh", "encryption_context": {"request_id": "req-0a1b2c3d"}},
  "raw_payload_bytes": 82124
}
```
Note: raw_payload_bytes reported 82k — Splunk HEC in this customer's cluster has a 64k line limit, so adapter truncated.

raj: KMS decrypt failures likely from how we encode the encryption_context header for S3 PUT. We're URL-encoding the JSON; KMS expects base64-encoded JSON for the context when used via SSE-KMS + context. Fix: base64(JSON) and set `x-amz-server-side-encryption-context` accordingly. Also ensure `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` is the full ARN. I'll put a test in.

olivia: For Splunk HEC, some customers lower the `max_content_length` or put proxy limits (nginx `client_max_body_size`). Best practice: webhook should check configurable `max_target_payload` and respond with 413 + `Retry-After` when event > limit and include a minimal envelope to let adapter re-request or route to S3 export.

sec-bot: Automated note: audit-schema v2 rollout scheduled for 2026-03-25. Review migration guide: https://redwood.example/docs/audit-schema-v2 :rotating_light:

michael: Action items: (1) raj — implement base64 encoding for encryption_context + unit test; (2) olivia — modify adapter to forward X-RW-Audit-Bytes and include fallback envelope for >60k payloads; (3) eva — run canary against Acme with both Splunk HEC and S3 export. ETA EOD tomorrow?

raj: :thumbsup: Opening PR now. Will add unit test for header encoding and a small integration test that uploads to signed S3 URL. Curl for signed PUT I'll include in PR:
```bash
curl -X PUT "${SIGNED_URL}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --upload-file sample.ndjson
```
And for KMS context header encoding (python):
```py
import base64, json
ctx = json.dumps({"request_id": "req-0a1b2c3d"}).encode('utf-8')
header = base64.b64encode(ctx).decode('ascii')
# set x-amz-server-side-encryption-context: header
```

eva: I'll validate with Splunk HEC using the HEC token: `curl -X POST https://hec.example/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' --data-binary @sample.ndjson` and report metrics `audit_adapter.ingest.payload_too_large` and `audit_adapter.kms.decrypt_fail`. Will tag results here.

olivia: If customers see truncation, ask them to check: proxy limits, Splunk HEC `max_content_length`, and our adapter logs. Signal to CS: include the short checklist template I posted earlier: `check proxy/nginx, check adapter-forward-headers, try S3 route`.

michael: I'll pause Acme onboarding until canary passes and will coordinate with CS to send the checklist. Thanks all. :handshake:

olivia: FYI I'm going to add a small migration note in onboarding docs: "If your SIEM strips headers, enable S3 export or use our Splunk forwarder v2 which preserves X-RW-* headers."

raj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-exports/pull/987 (will link tests)

sec-bot: Reminder: please add a changelog entry under `audit-exports` for the encoding fix to help customers with troubleshooting.

michael: Good call. I'll draft the changelog + CS blurb after PR merges.
